a partly owned render target is rebuilt only in the blocks it does not own (Sky Garden tiler traffic 2.4 -> 1.8-2.0 GB/s)

column4: the G-buffer copy the decals read takes the scaled render size (Upscaling 720p/900p, Render scale 540p) instead of the native level size: no yellow/red tint or stripes on wet Astro
a write fault on GPU bytes whose writers completed copies them on the host instead of waiting for the GPU backlog (fewer CPU stalls; no frame-rate gain measured)
a draw waits at most 8 s for a pipeline build that never returns, then is skipped until it does (freeze seen once, 2026-11-22)
closing the window exits within 5 s even if the pipeline cache save is stuck
